lines.text: ERP phase 1 live since July 1. Phase 2 now Q1 2027 per the August report. No revised budget since March.
Dayton lease exit signed in March. No move date stated in any report since.
Pricing live in Northeast and Southeast. Midwest scheduled for September.
TMS decision down to two vendors. Corvus already chose from a two-vendor bake-off in May.
Whitfield frames the ERP slip as vendor resourcing. Internal data owner not confirmed.
CFO offer accepted August 20, start September 15.
Driver turnover 46% in August, up from 44% in May. No new actions named in the report.
Pricing live in all regions since June. Gross margin 27.9% in July versus 26.1% in March; the report does not connect the two.
Warehouse pilot equipment installed. First throughput read expected in September.
Sales comp changed in March ahead of the pricing rollout. Confirmed as the reason it held.
Warehouse system integration is not on the pilot schedule. September read may be a manual count.
Hangar 3 online date moved twice: October in May, December in July. August cites vendor resourcing with no new date.
Two territory sales roles last mentioned in March. Nothing since.
TMS vendor selected in May. Contract in legal as of August.
Top customer 33% of revenue, down from 38% in January. Target under 30%.
Hangar projects have never hit the first date given. Plan on the second date.
